label: For "Grid Agent Action Guardrails": Constrain and record every action AI agents take around switching orders, outage tickets and SCADA setpoints so that operators stay in control of the grid and regulators can see what happened. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Agents with standing write rights.
